lines.text: Satan stands at the right hand of Joshua the high priest to accuse him, and the LORD rebukes Satan.
Joshua stands in filthy garments, and the angel orders them to take off his filthy clothes and promises splendid robes.
Zechariah asks for a golden turban on Joshua's head, and they clothe him while the angel of the LORD stands by.
If Joshua walks in the LORD's ways, he will govern His house, and the LORD will bring His servant, the Branch.
The LORD will remove the land's iniquity in a single day, and neighbors will be invited to sit under the cedar and olive tree.
